# Testing

A test is a program that **fails when the behavior you care about changes**. This book’s default is **pytest**.

## Planned chapters

| Chapter | Focus |
|---------|--------|
| First pytest | `assert`, discovery, `uv add --dev pytest` |
| Fixtures | Setup without copy-paste |
| Parametrize | Many examples, one test |
| Hypothesis | Property tests |
| Testing I/O | `tmp_path`, mocks as a last resort |

Until these leaves exist: write `assert c_to_f(0) == 32` in `test_celsius.py` and run `uv run pytest`. Slatkin’s *Effective Python* has collaboration/testing items; the pytest docs are the reference.
